summary: ChatGPT is a world‑class conversational assistant evolving toward agents and automation. Super is built specifically for people who want a personal AI agent that actually operates a computer — and gets better and cheaper at repeated workflows through a reusable computer-use cache. This page compares where ChatGPT shines, where it’s still maturing, and why Super is the sharper alternative for durable computer-use work.
